_comment: Vision model catalog. Data, not code, so adding a model is an edit here and never a change to routing. Every entry was checked against the Ollama registry before being listed -- the `verified` field records the size actually reported by the registry manifest, not an estimate. Sizes are the download size on disk, which for Ollama is the quantised runtime size.
_budget_note: required_vram_gb is NOT the download size. It is download size + projector + the vision encoder's activation buffer at full screen + a KV reserve. A vision model that fits its weights and then OOMs the first time it is pointed at a 1920x1080 screenshot is the single most common way a local VLM disappoints, so the number is deliberately pessimistic.

models.strengths: Best text-in-image quality here -- reads screenshots, code in images, tables, small UI text
models.tradeoffs: Heaviest of the good options; needs ~5.8 GB free

models.strengths: Smallest model that still reads text in images reliably
models.tradeoffs: Weaker on dense or cluttered screens

models.strengths: Solid general screenshots, lighter than the 4B
Good at describing scenes, natural captions
models.tradeoffs: Noticeably weaker at reading text in an image than Qwen3-VL
Dated. Will not fit most 8 GB cards once the vision buffer is counted
Poor OCR -- it will not reliably read text in a screenshot
